title: Eldritch Bone Demon
description: A muscular purple demon with white skull-like head and long claws crouches in the center of a dark, chaotic scene. It is surrounded by tangled organic tentacles, scattered bones, and glowing geometric crystalline structures in white and gold that float in the smoky air.
prompt: A muscular purple demonic creature with a white skull head and long claws crouching amidst a chaotic mass of dark writhing tentacles and scattered bones. Floating geometric crystalline structures in glowing white and gold energy patterns surround the scene, dark smoky atmosphere, horror fantasy setting, highly detailed digital painting.
